thesis: The speaker argues that investors should build their own investment frameworks because relying on someone else's is unsustainable when economic conditions change. The book aims to provide a structured mindset and process to help investors filter the universe of opportunities by answering four key questions, starting with whether an opportunity is investible due to mispricing or a good business, followed by assessing if the valuation is attractive.
